rules.description: Must import axe from vitest-axe, jest-axe, or @axe-core
Component must be rendered with render() in the test
Must include at least one keyboard interaction test
Should assert ARIA attributes via getByRole or aria-*
Tests must target WCAG 2.1 AA compliance level
Modal/dialog/drawer components must test focus trap
Color contrast violations must be caught by axe-core
